mapper.select: SELECT project_id AS projectId, project_name AS projectName, status, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate FROM project ORDER BY project_id

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, MAX(CASE WHEN ps.stage_no = 1 THEN ps.status END) AS stage1Status, MAX(CASE WHEN ps.stage_no = 2 THEN ps.status END) AS stage2Status, MAX(CASE WHEN ps.stage_no = 3 THEN ps.status END) AS stage3Status FROM project p LEFT JOIN project_stage ps ON p.project_id = ps.project_id GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name ORDER BY p.project_id
